name: secondopinion
description: Global file-based mailbox for Codex→Claude Code review exchanges: the secondopinion-request skill creates, publishes, waits for and reads exchanges in the ~/.secondopinion store (requires the secondopinion CLI on PATH; see install.sh).

interface.shortDescription: Hands-free second opinions from Claude Code, right from Codex
interface.longDescription: secondopinion lets Codex ask Claude Code for an independent review, red-team, verification or diagnosis and get the answer back without any user intervention. One command publishes a hash-bound request recorded against the exact checkout, runs a headless Claude Code responder that never prompts, and returns the validated answer. Works across repositories, git worktrees and sessions.
defaultPrompt: Get a second opinion from Claude on this change.
Ask Claude to red-team this design.
Ask Claude to red-team the design decision I just made and refute it if it can
Ask Claude to verify my last bug fix actually addresses the root cause
